title: Raised Identifiers in Exercise Material

illustrates.quote: Identifiers may appear raised from the baseline in print. Ignore this raised position in braille. Note: This does not apply to reference indicators. (See Formats, §16.2.2, Reference Marks.)

blocks.text: He was born in the year 1.\_ in the state of 2.\_. He grew up in 3.\_. Before moving to Texas, his family 4.\_ but 5.\_.

print.printFeatures: The identifiers 1.-5. are printed raised (superscript) above the baseline; braille ignores the raised position per 10.6.11c.

braille.notes: Independently re-extracted from source (fixed left margin / line-number field stripped by counting; U+2800→space; trailing spaces removed); confirmed byte-identical to both run A and run B (gold-10-A/gold-10-B) except where differences.md records a correction.

resolution: Braille matches both A and B exactly. Print unchanged from A/B.
